app.title: Show HN: Foolscap – a writing app that reads your book and never writes for you
app.description: A writing application that consumes your book content and provides context-aware assistance without generating text.
proposed_tests: Install foolscap via npm and launch CLI help
Create a new project file and add a short text, then use the "read" command to fetch context
Run the API endpoint to verify it returns contextual suggestions
Measure launch time and memory usage
Validate that the tool does not auto-generate content without user prompt
